svg_led_circuit:
<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 340 160" width="340" height="160" style="background:#f8fafc;border-radius:8px">
  <defs>
    <marker id="arr" markerWidth="8" markerHeight="8" refX="4" refY="4" orient="auto">
      <path d="M0,0 L8,4 L0,8 Z" fill="#0ea5e9"/>
    </marker>
  </defs>
  <!-- GPIO PIN -->
  <rect id="led-gpio" x="10" y="60" width="60" height="36" rx="6" fill="#0ea5e9" stroke="#0284c7" stroke-width="2"/>
  <text x="40" y="82" text-anchor="middle" fill="white" font-size="11" font-weight="bold">GPIO</text>
  <!-- wire to R -->
  <line x1="70" y1="78" x2="110" y2="78" stroke="#334155" stroke-width="2.5"/>

  <line x1="170" y1="78" x2="210" y2="78" stroke="#334155" stroke-width="2.5"/>

  <line x1="248" y1="62" x2="262" y2="52" stroke="#fbbf24" stroke-width="2" stroke-dasharray="4,2"/>
  <line x1="248" y1="72" x2="265" y2="66" stroke="#fbbf24" stroke-width="2" stroke-dasharray="4,2"/>

  <line x1="240" y1="78" x2="290" y2="78" stroke="#334155" stroke-width="2.5"/>

  <text x="225" y="108" text-anchor="middle" fill="#15803d" font-size="10">LED</text>

  <!-- Current arrow -->
  <text x="175" y="70" text-anchor="middle" fill="#0ea5e9" font-size="9">→ 约6mA</text>
</svg>
svg_timer_principle:
<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 400 150" width="400" height="150" style="background:#f8fafc;border-radius:8px">
  <!-- Clock source -->
  <rect x="10" y="55" width="65" height="40" rx="6" fill="#0ea5e9" fill-opacity="0.15" stroke="#0ea5e9" stroke-width="2"/>
  <text x="42" y="71" text-anchor="middle" fill="#0ea5e9" font-size="9" font-weight="bold">系统时钟</text>
  <text x="42" y="85" text-anchor="middle" fill="#0ea5e9" font-size="9">72MHz</text>
  <!-- arrow -->
  <line x1="75" y1="75" x2="100" y2="75" stroke="#334155" stroke-width="2" marker-end="url(#a)"/>
  <defs><marker id="a" markerWidth="6" markerHeight="6" refX="5" refY="3" orient="auto"><path d="M0,0L6,3L0,6Z" fill="#334155"/></marker></defs>
  <!-- PSC -->
  <rect x="100" y="55" width="75" height="40" rx="6" fill="#f59e0b" fill-opacity="0.15" stroke="#f59e0b" stroke-width="2"/>
  <text x="137" y="72" text-anchor="middle" fill="#92400e" font-size="10" font-weight="bold">PSC预分频</text>
  <text x="137" y="86" text-anchor="middle" fill="#92400e" font-size="9">÷(PSC+1)</text>
  <line x1="175" y1="75" x2="200" y2="75" stroke="#334155" stroke-width="2" marker-end="url(#a)"/>
  <!-- Counter -->
  <rect x="200" y="45" width="90" height="60" rx="6" fill="#8b5cf6" fill-opacity="0.15" stroke="#8b5cf6" stroke-width="2"/>
  <text x="245" y="68" text-anchor="middle" fill="#6d28d9" font-size="10" font-weight="bold">CNT计数器</text>
  <text x="245" y="82" text-anchor="middle" fill="#6d28d9" font-size="9">0 → ARR</text>
  <text x="245" y="96" text-anchor="middle" fill="#6d28d9" font-size="9">↑ 溢出中断</text>
  <line x1="290" y1="75" x2="315" y2="75" stroke="#334155" stroke-width="2" marker-end="url(#a)"/>
  <!-- Output -->
  <rect x="315" y="55" width="75" height="40" rx="6" fill="#22c55e" fill-opacity="0.15" stroke="#22c55e" stroke-width="2"/>
  <text x="352" y="72" text-anchor="middle" fill="#15803d" font-size="10" font-weight="bold">UEV溢出</text>
  <text x="352" y="86" text-anchor="middle" fill="#15803d" font-size="9">→ 中断/DMA</text>
  <!-- Formula -->
  <text x="200" y="130" text-anchor="middle" fill="#334155" font-size="10">溢出周期 = (PSC+1)×(ARR+1) / 系统时钟频率</text>
  <text x="200" y="145" text-anchor="middle" fill="#0ea5e9" font-size="9">示例: PSC=71, ARR=999 → 72MHz → 1ms精确定时</text>
</svg>
svg_pwm_waveform:
<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 400 130" width="400" height="130" style="background:#0f172a;border-radius:8px">
  <text x="200" y="16" text-anchor="middle" fill="#e2e8f0" font-size="11" font-weight="bold">PWM 波形 · 占空比与等效电压</text>
  <!-- 25% duty -->
  <text x="20" y="36" fill="#94a3b8" font-size="9">25%</text>
  <polyline points="40,28 40,44 60,44 60,28 100,28 100,44 140,44 140,28 180,28 180,44 220,44 220,28" stroke="#0ea5e9" stroke-width="2" fill="none"/>
  <line x1="230" y1="36" x2="390" y2="36" stroke="#64748b" stroke-width="1" stroke-dasharray="4,3"/>
  <text x="395" y="39" fill="#fbbf24" font-size="8">≈0.8V</text>
  <!-- 50% duty -->
  <text x="20" y="70" fill="#94a3b8" font-size="9">50%</text>
  <polyline points="40,62 40,78 70,78 70,62 110,62 110,78 140,78 140,62 180,62 180,78 210,78 210,62" stroke="#22c55e" stroke-width="2" fill="none"/>
  <line x1="230" y1="70" x2="390" y2="70" stroke="#64748b" stroke-width="1" stroke-dasharray="4,3"/>
  <text x="395" y="73" fill="#fbbf24" font-size="8">≈1.65V</text>
  <!-- 75% duty -->
  <text x="20" y="104" fill="#94a3b8" font-size="9">75%</text>
  <polyline points="40,96 40,112 90,112 90,96 130,96 130,112 170,112 170,96 210,96 210,112 230,112 230,96" stroke="#f59e0b" stroke-width="2" fill="none"/>
  <line x1="240" y1="104" x2="390" y2="104" stroke="#64748b" stroke-width="1" stroke-dasharray="4,3"/>
  <text x="395" y="107" fill="#fbbf24" font-size="8">≈2.5V</text>
  <!-- Period arrow -->
  <line x1="40" y1="120" x2="180" y2="120" stroke="#64748b" stroke-width="1.5" marker-end="url(#c)" marker-start="url(#d)"/>
  <defs>
    <marker id="c" markerWidth="5" markerHeight="5" refX="4" refY="2.5" orient="auto"><path d="M0,0L5,2.5L0,5Z" fill="#64748b"/></marker>
    <marker id="d" markerWidth="5" markerHeight="5" refX="1" refY="2.5" orient="auto"><path d="M5,0L0,2.5L5,5Z" fill="#64748b"/></marker>
  </defs>
  <text x="110" y="128" text-anchor="middle" fill="#64748b" font-size="8">← 一个PWM周期(ARR+1个计数) →</text>
</svg>
svg_uart_frame:
<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 400 120" width="400" height="120" style="background:#0f172a;border-radius:8px">
  <!-- idle high -->
  <line x1="10" y1="30" x2="50" y2="30" stroke="#22c55e" stroke-width="2.5"/>
  <!-- start bit (low) -->
  <line x1="50" y1="30" x2="50" y2="80" stroke="#22c55e" stroke-width="2.5"/>
  <line x1="50" y1="80" x2="80" y2="80" stroke="#ef4444" stroke-width="2.5"/>
  <!-- 8 data bits -->
  <line x1="80" y1="80" x2="80" y2="30" stroke="#22c55e" stroke-width="2.5"/>
  <line x1="80" y1="30" x2="110" y2="30" stroke="#22c55e" stroke-width="2.5"/>
  <line x1="110" y1="30" x2="110" y2="80" stroke="#22c55e" stroke-width="2.5"/>
  <line x1="110" y1="80" x2="140" y2="80" stroke="#22c55e" stroke-width="2.5"/>
  <line x1="140" y1="80" x2="140" y2="30" stroke="#22c55e" stroke-width="2.5"/>
  <line x1="140" y1="30" x2="200" y2="30" stroke="#22c55e" stroke-width="2.5"/>
  <line x1="200" y1="30" x2="200" y2="80" stroke="#22c55e" stroke-width="2.5"/>
  <line x1="200" y1="80" x2="260" y2="80" stroke="#22c55e" stroke-width="2.5"/>
  <line x1="260" y1="80" x2="260" y2="30" stroke="#22c55e" stroke-width="2.5"/>
  <line x1="260" y1="30" x2="310" y2="30" stroke="#22c55e" stroke-width="2.5"/>
  <!-- stop bit (high) -->
  <line x1="310" y1="30" x2="360" y2="30" stroke="#22c55e" stroke-width="2.5"/>
  <!-- idle -->
  <line x1="360" y1="30" x2="390" y2="30" stroke="#22c55e" stroke-width="2.5"/>
  <!-- Labels -->
  <text x="30" y="18" text-anchor="middle" fill="#94a3b8" font-size="9">IDLE</text>
  <text x="65" y="96" text-anchor="middle" fill="#ef4444" font-size="9">START</text>
  <text x="185" y="18" text-anchor="middle" fill="#fbbf24" font-size="9">D7  D6  D5  D4  D3  D2  D1  D0</text>
  <text x="335" y="18" text-anchor="middle" fill="#22c55e" font-size="9">STOP</text>
  <text x="200" y="110" text-anchor="middle" fill="#64748b" font-size="9">← 1位起始 + 8位数据（LSB先） + 1位停止 → 波特率决定每位时长</text>
  <!-- High/Low labels -->
  <text x="5" y="34" fill="#22c55e" font-size="8">H</text>
  <text x="5" y="84" fill="#ef4444" font-size="8">L</text>
</svg>
svg_adc_process:
<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 400 140" width="400" height="140" style="background:#f8fafc;border-radius:8px">
  <text x="200" y="16" text-anchor="middle" fill="#0f172a" font-size="12" font-weight="bold">ADC 模数转换过程（12位）</text>
  <!-- Analog signal -->
  <text x="60" y="36" text-anchor="middle" fill="#0ea5e9" font-size="10">模拟信号</text>
  <path d="M10,70 Q30,45 50,70 Q70,95 90,70 Q110,45 120,70" stroke="#0ea5e9" stroke-width="2" fill="none"/>
  <!-- arrow -->
  <line x1="125" y1="70" x2="155" y2="70" stroke="#334155" stroke-width="2" marker-end="url(#b)"/>
  <defs><marker id="b" markerWidth="6" markerHeight="6" refX="5" refY="3" orient="auto"><path d="M0,0L6,3L0,6Z" fill="#334155"/></marker></defs>
  <text x="140" y="60" text-anchor="middle" fill="#64748b" font-size="8">采样</text>
  <!-- Sampling hold -->
  <rect x="155" y="50" width="60" height="40" rx="4" fill="#fef9c3" stroke="#ca8a04" stroke-width="1.5"/>
  <text x="185" y="68" text-anchor="middle" fill="#92400e" font-size="9" font-weight="bold">采样保持</text>
  <text x="185" y="82" text-anchor="middle" fill="#92400e" font-size="8">S/H</text>
  <line x1="215" y1="70" x2="245" y2="70" stroke="#334155" stroke-width="2" marker-end="url(#b)"/>
  <text x="230" y="60" text-anchor="middle" fill="#64748b" font-size="8">量化</text>
  <!-- ADC core -->
  <rect x="245" y="50" width="60" height="40" rx="4" fill="#22c55e" fill-opacity="0.15" stroke="#22c55e" stroke-width="1.5"/>
  <text x="275" y="68" text-anchor="middle" fill="#15803d" font-size="9" font-weight="bold">逐次逼近</text>
  <text x="275" y="82" text-anchor="middle" fill="#15803d" font-size="8">SAR ADC</text>
  <line x1="305" y1="70" x2="335" y2="70" stroke="#334155" stroke-width="2" marker-end="url(#b)"/>
  <text x="320" y="60" text-anchor="middle" fill="#64748b" font-size="8">编码</text>
  <!-- Digital output -->
  <rect x="335" y="50" width="58" height="40" rx="4" fill="#8b5cf6" fill-opacity="0.15" stroke="#8b5cf6" stroke-width="1.5"/>
  <text x="364" y="68" text-anchor="middle" fill="#6d28d9" font-size="9" font-weight="bold">数字值</text>
  <text x="364" y="82" text-anchor="middle" fill="#6d28d9" font-size="8">0~4095</text>
  <!-- formula -->
  <text x="200" y="115" text-anchor="middle" fill="#334155" font-size="10">电压 = ADC值 × VREF / 4096</text>
  <text x="200" y="130" text-anchor="middle" fill="#0ea5e9" font-size="9">分辨率 = 3.3V / 4096 ≈ 0.8mV/LSB（12位，VREF=3.3V）</text>
</svg>
svg_i2c_protocol:
<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 420 130" width="420" height="130" style="background:#0f172a;border-radius:8px">
  <text x="210" y="14" text-anchor="middle" fill="#e2e8f0" font-size="11" font-weight="bold">I2C 通信时序（主设备发送）</text>
  <!-- Labels -->
  <text x="8" y="38" fill="#94a3b8" font-size="9">SCL</text>
  <text x="8" y="78" fill="#94a3b8" font-size="9">SDA</text>

svg_hcsr04_timing:
<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 440 150" width="440" height="150" style="background:#0f172a;border-radius:8px">
  <text x="220" y="14" text-anchor="middle" fill="#e2e8f0" font-size="11" font-weight="bold">HC-SR04 超声波测距时序</text>
  <!-- TRIG label -->
  <text x="28" y="38" fill="#94a3b8" font-size="9" text-anchor="middle">TRIG</text>
  <!-- TRIG signal: idle low, 10us high pulse -->
  <line x1="45" y1="45" x2="80" y2="45" stroke="#0ea5e9" stroke-width="2"/>
  <line x1="80" y1="45" x2="80" y2="30" stroke="#0ea5e9" stroke-width="2"/>
  <line x1="80" y1="30" x2="100" y2="30" stroke="#0ea5e9" stroke-width="2"/>
  <line x1="100" y1="30" x2="100" y2="45" stroke="#0ea5e9" stroke-width="2"/>
  <line x1="100" y1="45" x2="420" y2="45" stroke="#0ea5e9" stroke-width="2"/>
  <text x="90" y="26" text-anchor="middle" fill="#fbbf24" font-size="8">10μs</text>
  <!-- ECHO label -->
  <text x="28" y="78" fill="#94a3b8" font-size="9" text-anchor="middle">ECHO</text>
  <!-- ECHO signal: idle low, high pulse proportional to distance -->
  <line x1="45" y1="85" x2="120" y2="85" stroke="#22c55e" stroke-width="2"/>
  <line x1="120" y1="85" x2="120" y2="65" stroke="#22c55e" stroke-width="2"/>
  <line x1="120" y1="65" x2="300" y2="65" stroke="#22c55e" stroke-width="2"/>
  <line x1="300" y1="65" x2="300" y2="85" stroke="#22c55e" stroke-width="2"/>
  <line x1="300" y1="85" x2="420" y2="85" stroke="#22c55e" stroke-width="2"/>
  <!-- ECHO duration label -->
  <line x1="120" y1="58" x2="300" y2="58" stroke="#fbbf24" stroke-width="1" stroke-dasharray="3,2"/>
  <text x="210" y="56" text-anchor="middle" fill="#fbbf24" font-size="9">t = ECHO高电平时间(μs)</text>
  <!-- Ultrasonic waves -->
  <text x="130" y="110" fill="#8b5cf6" font-size="9">发射超声波</text>
  <text x="240" y="110" fill="#ef4444" font-size="9">遇障碍物反射</text>
  <line x1="120" y1="100" x2="120" y2="90" stroke="#8b5cf6" stroke-width="1" stroke-dasharray="2,2"/>
  <line x1="300" y1="100" x2="300" y2="90" stroke="#ef4444" stroke-width="1" stroke-dasharray="2,2"/>
  <!-- Formula -->
  <text x="220" y="130" text-anchor="middle" fill="#94a3b8" font-size="10">距离(cm) = t(μs) × 0.034 / 2</text>
  <text x="220" y="145" text-anchor="middle" fill="#64748b" font-size="9">示例：t=580μs → 距离≈9.86cm≈10cm</text>
</svg>

svg_parking_state_machine:
<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 460 160" width="460" height="160" style="background:#f8fafc;border-radius:8px">

svg_step_counter_algo:
<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 360 200" width="360" height="200" style="background:#f8fafc;border-radius:8px">
  <text x="180" y="16" text-anchor="middle" fill="#0f172a" font-size="12" font-weight="bold">峰值检测计步算法流程</text>
  <defs><marker id="fa" markerWidth="6" markerHeight="6" refX="5" refY="3" orient="auto"><path d="M0,0L6,3L0,6Z" fill="#334155"/></marker></defs>
  <!-- Step 1 -->
  <rect x="110" y="25" width="140" height="28" rx="6" fill="#0ea5e9" fill-opacity="0.15" stroke="#0ea5e9" stroke-width="1.5"/>
  <text x="180" y="43" text-anchor="middle" fill="#0369a1" font-size="9">读取三轴加速度 ax,ay,az</text>
  <!-- Step 2 -->
  <line x1="180" y1="53" x2="180" y2="65" stroke="#334155" stroke-width="1.5" marker-end="url(#fa)"/>
  <rect x="100" y="65" width="160" height="28" rx="6" fill="#f59e0b" fill-opacity="0.15" stroke="#f59e0b" stroke-width="1.5"/>
  <text x="180" y="83" text-anchor="middle" fill="#92400e" font-size="9">计算合加速度 mag=√(ax²+ay²+az²)</text>
  <!-- Step 3 -->
  <line x1="180" y1="93" x2="180" y2="105" stroke="#334155" stroke-width="1.5" marker-end="url(#fa)"/>
  <rect x="90" y="105" width="180" height="28" rx="6" fill="#8b5cf6" fill-opacity="0.15" stroke="#8b5cf6" stroke-width="1.5"/>
  <text x="180" y="120" text-anchor="middle" fill="#6d28d9" font-size="9">mag > prev && prev > pprev?</text>
  <text x="180" y="130" text-anchor="middle" fill="#6d28d9" font-size="8">（检测到峰值）</text>
  <!-- Yes branch -->
  <line x1="270" y1="119" x2="310" y2="119" stroke="#22c55e" stroke-width="1.5" marker-end="url(#fa)"/>
  <text x="290" y="113" fill="#22c55e" font-size="8">是</text>
  <rect x="310" y="105" width="40" height="28" rx="4" fill="#22c55e" fill-opacity="0.15" stroke="#22c55e" stroke-width="1.5"/>
  <text x="330" y="122" text-anchor="middle" fill="#15803d" font-size="8">mag>阈值?</text>
  <!-- No branch -->
  <line x1="180" y1="133" x2="180" y2="155" stroke="#ef4444" stroke-width="1.5" marker-end="url(#fa)"/>
  <text x="165" y="148" fill="#ef4444" font-size="8">否</text>
  <!-- Update -->
  <rect x="100" y="155" width="160" height="28" rx="6" fill="#64748b" fill-opacity="0.15" stroke="#64748b" stroke-width="1.5"/>
  <text x="180" y="173" text-anchor="middle" fill="#334155" font-size="9">pprev=prev; prev=mag; 继续</text>
  <!-- Step count -->
  <line x1="330" y1="133" x2="330" y2="155" stroke="#22c55e" stroke-width="1.5" marker-end="url(#fa)"/>
  <rect x="300" y="155" width="55" height="28" rx="4" fill="#22c55e" fill-opacity="0.2" stroke="#22c55e" stroke-width="1.5"/>
  <text x="327" y="170" text-anchor="middle" fill="#15803d" font-size="8">步数+1</text>
  <text x="327" y="180" text-anchor="middle" fill="#15803d" font-size="7">防抖300ms</text>
</svg>
svg_pid_block:
<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 460 140" width="460" height="140" style="background:#f8fafc;border-radius:8px">

  <!-- Setpoint -->
  <text x="18" y="78" fill="#0ea5e9" font-size="10" font-weight="bold">目标值</text>
  <text x="18" y="90" fill="#0ea5e9" font-size="9">r(t)</text>

  <line x1="38" y1="80" x2="76" y2="80" stroke="#334155" stroke-width="1.5" marker-end="url(#pa)"/>
  <!-- Error label -->
  <text x="115" y="72" fill="#ef4444" font-size="9">误差e(t)</text>
  <line x1="104" y1="80" x2="140" y2="80" stroke="#334155" stroke-width="1.5" marker-end="url(#pa)"/>

  <text x="190" y="77" text-anchor="middle" fill="#6d28d9" font-size="10" font-weight="bold">PID控制器</text>
  <text x="190" y="92" text-anchor="middle" fill="#6d28d9" font-size="8">Kp·e + Ki·∫e + Kd·ė</text>
  <!-- Output -->
  <line x1="240" y1="80" x2="275" y2="80" stroke="#334155" stroke-width="1.5" marker-end="url(#pa)"/>
  <text x="258" y="72" fill="#64748b" font-size="9">u(t)</text>
  <!-- Plant/System -->
  <rect x="275" y="60" width="90" height="40" rx="6" fill="#f59e0b" fill-opacity="0.15" stroke="#f59e0b" stroke-width="2"/>
  <text x="320" y="77" text-anchor="middle" fill="#92400e" font-size="10" font-weight="bold">被控对象</text>
  <text x="320" y="92" text-anchor="middle" fill="#92400e" font-size="8">舵机/电机</text>
  <!-- Output -->
  <line x1="365" y1="80" x2="420" y2="80" stroke="#334155" stroke-width="1.5" marker-end="url(#pa)"/>

  <text x="430" y="90" fill="#22c55e" font-size="9">y(t)</text>
  <!-- Feedback -->
  <line x1="392" y1="80" x2="392" y2="118" stroke="#334155" stroke-width="1.5"/>
  <line x1="392" y1="118" x2="90" y2="118" stroke="#334155" stroke-width="1.5"/>
  <line x1="90" y1="118" x2="90" y2="94" stroke="#334155" stroke-width="1.5" marker-end="url(#pa)"/>
  <text x="240" y="132" text-anchor="middle" fill="#64748b" font-size="9">← 反馈（传感器测量值）</text>
  <!-- Minus sign at sum -->
  <text x="82" y="96" fill="#ef4444" font-size="10" font-weight="bold">−</text>
</svg>
